handoff: review#3: review#2 fixes hold, D1–D5 code sound and traced, tests green. Blocking (skill text): F1 norn-fsd-round says the round ends at $stuck (contradicts B13/B27, RD1); F2 the --until gate wait returns at once on a gate the skill leaves parked (B19/B20/B39), busy-loop. Minor: run cancel not in SK3/B16, B21/B22 negatives + B34 run view unasserted, schema comment-with-delegated unenforced, per-load round reads, 'supervisor' undefined in concepts.md. Table in handoff.

findings.title: Round said to end at $stuck
findings.detail:
'When the round ends': 'The round ends at `$done` or `$stuck` … Then the subagent reports and stops.' W7: $stuck parks the unit in Unblock; RD1: a round runs from its start step to $done, $done ends a round. B13 'a stuck unit diagnosed and retried once before it reaches me', B27 'stuck again at the same step after one diagnosed retry → escalated'. A subagent following the end-of-round rule reports a stuck unit instead of the one rerun.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say the round ends at $done (for story/quick once ready has its approve); a stuck unit gets the one diagnosed rerun, a second stuck is escalated. Pin with an assets term and a negative check for '$stuck' in that sentence.

findings.title: The wait loop busy-loops on a gate it must leave parked
findings.detail:
The brief loops on `norn story wait <story> --until gate --timeout 5m`; waitMet 'gate' holds whenever any unit is parked at a gate (packages/view/src/wait.ts:81), so it exits 0 at once. The skill orders waiting at a parked gate in B19 ('CI green on an older head → wait for the new run'), B20 ('A PR the person merged → wait for the story to end'), and B39/escalated gates (release ready waits on the person). In each the subagent spins on wait/view calls with no delay, contrary to 'No background polling'. Happy path only.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name a wait that does not return at once in those cases (e.g. `--until merged --timeout 5m` after a merge, or `--until step=<next> --timeout 5m` / a plain bounded wait while a gate is deliberately left), and assert the term in assets.test.ts.

findings.title: run cancel allowed but not in SK3 / B16
findings.detail:
The skill allows `norn run cancel` right before a suspected-flake rerun (needed for B42, run-rerun refuses running units), but B16's allowed list and SK3's command list omit it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name the narrow run cancel allowance in SK3 (and the spec's B16 example).

findings.title: Negative cases of B21/B22 and B34's run view not asserted
findings.detail:
B21 'a gate I approved myself shows no such mark' — no person-approved gate in the test; B22 'a story with none shows no such section' and D5 'never an inbox item' not asserted; B34 names `norn run view`, only run list is asserted. Weak asset terms: 'merge' (B24), 'load' (B41), '`quick`'/'`story`' (B33).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add the negative assertions and the run view check; tighten the terms.

findings.title: Comment claims comment is required with delegated; schema does not enforce
findings.detail:
receipt.ts:384,396,404 say comment is required with delegated; only the cli (human.ts) enforces it. A mailbox/hand-written receipt with delegated:true and no comment validates, and the view shows an empty reason (load.ts:463, trace-view.ts:656).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Enforce in the schema (if/then) or reword the comment.

findings.title: delegatedDecisions re-reads every round per view load
findings.detail:
loadRounds(story,{includeApplied:true}) on every loadProjectView; status --segment runs it every few seconds under Herdr (HC13), cost grows with rounds across all stories.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Accept with a comment, or compute only for story view/status --json, not the segment.

findings.title: 'supervisor' not defined in docs/concepts.md
findings.detail:
SK3 and every --delegated help use 'supervisor' as a noun; the glossary rule points to docs/concepts.md for definitions.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add a concepts.md entry.

findings.title: Small duplications and leftovers
findings.detail:
answer suffix duplicated in steps.ts:585 and timeline.ts:621; 'delegated (supervisor)' literal again in format.ts:418; two stacked JSDoc blocks on DelegatedKind (types.ts:670); status.ts:141-146 builds an inbox line outside @norn/view formatInbox; story-edit.ts checks delegated/reason twice (289, 318).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: answerSuffix helper + one mark constant; move the JSDoc; move the line into formatInbox.
